title: Australian-Style Vermicelli Bake
description: A simple and flavorful bake filled with Australian-style vermicelli and a blend of spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Oven-roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Cook the vermicelli according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Australian-style seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Add the oven-roasted vegetables and stir to combine.
Combine the cooked vermicelli, rice, and vegetable mixture in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
